items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Ivy Anderson sang, was hired to sing and they had a cake so big

ctx.x: So they pulled me in the car. They said, well if you can't make up your mind we'll make it up for you. And they pulled me in the car and I got out there about almost an hour and a half late. And boy, Duke had his hands, his head in his hands like this. see Duke You never worry much do you? Boy he was very upset. Jesus Christ what have I done? If this guy don't show up I'm in deep trouble. So I, when I showed up my wife's mother was going crazy. She was crying and raising hell and everybody was all upset because I…

But when I got there everybody came to life. Cootie growled the wedding march. And the pastor married us with the news cameras right down on us. All the chorus girls and everybody was sitting around like a big coliseum and the Mills Brother sang and Ivy Anderson sang. And they had the wedding. I was married. And that's the way I got married.
